alignment_ate_rpe: SE(3) Umeyama, all matched poses, no scale

drift_curve_alignment.skip_start_meaning: alignment window starts at the first matched pose at or after the first estimated pose + skip_start_s; error rows still cover all poses, distance from the first matched pose
drift_curve_alignment.error_split: horizontal = norm of (x,y) error; vertical = signed z error (est - gt)
drift_curve_alignment.comparison_curves: horizontal error with SE(3) alignment over all poses (cross-check), and with 4-DoF over all poses
drift_curve_alignment.tilt_check: roll/pitch (ZYX Euler, degrees) of the SE(3) rotation applied to the estimate
drift_curve_alignment.assumption: z axis along gravity in estimate and ground truth

rpe_segments: evo RPE translation_part, consecutive non-overlapping segments, length measured along the estimate's path (pairs_from_reference=False), after SE(3) alignment
